title: Shofar
summary: The shofar, often made from a ram’s horn, was used for alarm, worship, assembly, and sacred announcement.
background: Shofar blasts could call people together, announce feasts, signal danger, or mark solemn moments. It overlaps with broader trumpet language.
teachingHelp: Explain shofar sound as public and covenantal, connected with attention, alarm, and worship.
